sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-6b"
sources.quote: Kepler-6b is an extrasolar planet in the orbit of the unusually metal-rich Kepler-6, a star in the field of view of the NASA-operated Kepler spacecraft, which searches for planets that cross directly in front of, or transit, their host stars.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Kepler-6. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
